title: Nausea-Friendly Pregnancy Meals: Easy to Eat and Nutritious
excerpt: Smaller meals, gentler textures, and nutrient-dense snacks when morning sickness makes eating hard
content:
## Introduction to Morning Sickness and Prenatal Nutrition

When pregnant, experiencing morning sickness is a common phenomenon. However, morning sickness can make eating difficult, leading to a lack of essential nutrients for both the mother and the fetus. Therefore, choosing the right foods and building a scientific diet is crucial.

## Nutrient and Food Analysis

According to the World Health Organization (WHO), pregnant women need to ensure they are getting enough nutrients like iron, folic acid, calcium, and protein. However, when experiencing morning sickness, eating can be challenging. At this time, breaking meals into smaller portions, choosing easy-to-digest foods, and supplementing with nutrient-dense snacks is essential.

Some easy-to-digest and nutrient-dense foods that pregnant women can choose include:
- Easy-to-digest fruits and vegetables like bananas, apples, and carrots
- Dairy products like yogurt and cheese
- Cooked chicken and fish
- Whole grains and whole wheat bread

## Choosing Safe Foods

When pregnant, choosing safe foods is also important. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), pregnant women should avoid eating foods like:
- Uncooked sushi and sashimi
- Raw or undercooked seafood
- Undercooked meat and eggs
- Soft cheeses that have not been pasteurized

Instead, pregnant women can choose foods that have been cooked thoroughly and are safe. For example, a bowl of chicken noodle soup made with cooked chicken and easy-to-digest vegetables is a good option.

## Practical Tips and Building a Meal Plan

To build a scientific and safe meal plan, pregnant women can follow these tips:
- Break meals into 4-6 smaller meals per day
- Choose easy-to-digest and nutrient-dense foods
- Supplement with snacks like fruits, vegetables, and dairy products
- Avoid eating unsafe foods

Pregnant women can also refer to our [sample meal plan](/planner) for more ideas on building a scientific and safe diet.

## Conclusion

Choosing the right foods and building a scientific diet is crucial when pregnant. With these tips and information, pregnant women can build a meal plan that is easy to eat and still nutritious, ensuring health for both mother and fetus. If you have any questions, you can refer to [related topics](/blog/topics) on our website or consult with your doctor.

faqs.question: What should I eat when experiencing morning sickness?
faqs.answer: You should eat easy-to-digest and nutrient-dense foods like fruits, vegetables, dairy products, and cooked chicken

faqs.question: Can I eat sushi and sashimi when pregnant?
faqs.answer: No, you should avoid eating uncooked sushi and sashimi when pregnant because they may contain harmful bacteria and parasites
